components.name: openmotion-camera-fpga bitstream
components.description: Lattice CrossLink (LIF-MD6000) histogram FPGA bitstream, 163,489 bytes, merged at 0x081A0000 into the bare-metal-fpga and production images. Leftover from when the firmware loaded the FPGA SRAM at every boot: the camera FPGAs are now programmed into one-time-programmable NVCM at the factory, and the firmware skips the SRAM load when it detects an NVCM-booted FPGA (camera_manager.c program_fpga). The load path remains as a fallback. Not contained in the signed slot image. Its own SBOM: openmotion-camera-fpga-1.0.0.cdx.json.
